input: Ni cu vancung tang ah a tla i, khuachung lam hna ah a lummi ceunak a thlah. Mi hna cu lamkam ah an zam, an kedan cu lamkam ah a thang i biaruahnak cu aw-an ah aa cawh. Cafe ah, a thar in cawhmi coffee rim cu rawl kio rim he aa cawh i, a kalmi hna kha dinh le nuam tein um dingin a sawm hna. Lam cung hlasakthiam hna nih aw le aw-thawng an chap, khuapi cu aw le rong in a nungmi thilthuam ah an canter. Zanlei a hung tlai tikah, khuachung meiinn hna cu nunnak ah an ceu, khuachung nunnak i a harmi laam kha a ceuter i a ngol taktak bal lo.

A kau ngaimi tlang le a hringmi ramlak hna cung ah, thli nih thinghnah hna chungin biathli a chim. Ramlak saram hna cu thinghnah tangah an zam, an cawlcanghnak cu vancung mithmai zoh in dai tein tuahmi ballet bantuk a si. Tiva pakhat cu vawlei cung ah zaangfah tein a tlik, a cunglei nih a tlongmi ni ceunak kha a langhter i mit a lawmhtermi a ceumi hmanthlak a ser. Vate nih cun vawlei cung thilnung tuanbia a chim bantuk in hla an sak, daihnak ah a thangmi nunnak hla a si. Hi daihnak hmun ah hin, caan cu a tlawm deuhmi a lo, ruahnak cheuhnak le daihnak caan a chuahter.

Cauk chiahnak innpi chung ah, thil chiahnak kuang hna cu a dong lomi in an i kau, ruah khawhmi thil phunphun cauk in an khat. A hlun cangmi cauk le savun hri rim nih thli a khahter, hngalhnak hlathlaitu hna kha rel cawk lo vawlei ah luh dingin a sawm hna. Ca reltu hna cu a nuammi hmun le cabuai kau ah an ṭhu, an mit nih cahmai kha a zoh i an lungthin cu ruahnak, tuanbia le hmuhmi thil hna ah a vakvai. A caancaan ah, cahmai thlennak thawng nih lungthin peknak dai tein a ummi aw kha a kham. Lenglei ah, vawlei cu a tlik peng, asinain hi vampang chung ah hin, fimnak le khuaruah khawhnak universe cu dai tein dai tein a um.

A buaibai ngaimi chawdawr ah, thil zuartu hna nih an thilri pawl kha an au, aw thangpi lakah mipi lungthin lak an i zuam. Dawr pawl cu a nungmi thei, rimhmui rimhmui, le rong aa dawhmi thilpuan hna in an khat, thil pakhat cio nih a hramthawknak le thiamnak tuanbia a chim. Cawtu hna nih thil man kongah an i ceih i tuanbia an i hrawm, cu nih cun minung pehtlaihnak a nungmi hmanthlak a ser. Sa kio le changreu thlum rim cu thli lakah a hung chuak i, lamkaltu hna kha ei awkah a lem hna. Buainak lakah, a tanglei ah a ummi aw-thawng pakhat a um — market a nungmi le a thawmi a sitertu a tthawnnak, zatlang nun thlarau a hmunmi tehte a si.

Rili kaupi cungah, tilet nih tilawng cung a den i, thli lakah ti thlum a thlet. Lawng chung riantuantu hna cu tinhmi he an i chawk, tilawng hri pawl an remh i a kau ngaimi a senmi hmun ah an kal, arfi le thiamnak lawng nih lam an hruai hna. Vancung cu a dongh hngal loin a kau, zinglei in zanlei tiang aa thleng lengmangmi rong hna i vawlei dawhnak a langhter. Seagulls pawl cu an lu cung ah an i vel, an au thawng cu ti cung ah a thang, rili aw hna kha a karhter. Rili cu amah lawngte a um ko nain, a dong lomi vancung ah khualtlawnnak le hmuhchuahnak lungput a karh.

Khuapi park chung ah, ngakchia hna nih an i hnimhnak cu a thang i, annih cu lentecelhnak le tliknak ah an i celh. Chungkhar hna cu ramlak ah aa ṭhekmi puan cungah picnic an tuah, tuanbia an i hrawm i thingkung sang pipi hna thlalang tangah pakhat le pakhat an i nuam. A tlikmi le cycle mawngtu hna cu a tlikmi lam ah an kal, an cawlcanghnak nih khuapi nunnak lakah sermi thil hna i daihnak kha a ttha ngaimi hnulei ah a ser. Tidil cung ah vate le vok pawl cu dawh tein an zuang i daihnak a chuahter. Ni a hung tlai deuhdeuh tikah, park cu khuachung ummi hna nih an rian tam tukmi in dinhnak an hmuhnak hmun dai tein a ummi hmun ah aa thleng.

Tlangpar nih a pawngkam nelrawn le a hlatnak tlangpar hna kha khuaruahhar in a langhter. Tlang kai pawl cu mei hmete pawng ah an i pum, an khualtlawnnak kong tuanbia le hmailei khualtlawnnak kong an saduhthah an i hrawm. Thli cu a thiang i thazaang a petu a si, lung kha a thiangmi, a thartermi oxygen in a khahter. Lungpang hna ah vur tlawmpal aa hngat, ni ceunak tangah a ceu, vawlei muihnak le a tanglei thingram tlawmte he aa dang. Khuadawm nih a lanh tikah, thlalang hna nih vawlei cung ah an i celh, vawlei dawhnak a ttha lomi kha a langhter. Vawleicung cung ah dir in, pakhat nih caan a liam bal lomi sermi thil lianngannak he pehtlaihnak thukpi a ngei.

Khua pawng dai tein a ummi pawngkam ah, chungkhar hna nih an tuah tawnmi thil kha nem tein an tuah. Ngakchia pawl cu lamkam ah hopscotch an celh, an nih cu thli lakah a thang i nulepa nih a pawng i a ummi tual in ralring tein an zoh hna. Dum hna cu rong phunphun in an par — pangpar, tulip, daisies — an dihlak in ni ceunak le mipi lungthin laknak caah an i zuam. A thar in tanmi ramhring le a parmi pangpar rim nih innchungkhar a sining taktak a khumhmi sawmnak boruak a ser. Zanlei nih lam mei ceunak nemte le daihnak pehzulhnak a chuahpi i cucu theih loin a um tawn nain a sunsak tukmi a si.

Hlanlio rawhnak nih caan saupi a liam cangmi fimthiamnak tuanbia a chim, an lung vampang hna cu a rawk cang nain a hmunmi an si. Mitsur kung le hlinghro cu a tthennak ah an i tlik, caan a liam ning le minung sermi thilnung nih sermi thil a lak tthannak kha a langhter. Khualtlawngmi hna cu lamkam le tual hna ah an vakvai, hi inn hna chung i a rak ummi nunnak hna kha an mitthlam ah an cuanter. Daihnak cu a thuk ngai, kedan thawng le vate au thawng lawng nih a kham. Lung hna hnulei ah ni a tlak tikah, muihnak cu a sau deuh, cuka hmun cungah cun thilthup le upatnak thli a chuahter. Tuanbia a hmunmi le lung kip ah aa thupmi tuanbia hna kha a kan theihter ṭhan.

A buai ngaimi vanlawngbual dinhnak hmun ah, khualtlawngmi hna cu ruahchannak le saduhthahnak he an kal colh. Holh phunphun in biaruahnak nih thli a khahter tikah thilri phorhnak kedan pawl cu a ttha ngaimi inncung ah an i hninh. Digital screen nih chuahkehnak le phanhnak caan a langhter, lungsau lo asiloah lunglawm tein a ummi khualtlawng pawl kha an kalnak ding hmun lei ah a hruai hna. Coffee hrai le rawl hmete hna cu a cheukhat hmun ah an um, zing rawl ei rang tuk le caan donghnak timhtuahnak tehte a si. A ttha tein dirhmi buainak lakah, theihthiamnak i hrawmmi a um — hngalh lomi hna karlak ah pehtlaihnak caan tawite cu kawl, kir tthan, asiloah hramthawknak thar kawl duhnak lungput nih a hren hna. Khualtlawnnak cu pehzulh ding lawng a si zungzal.

Aa dawh ngaimi tikulh cungah, a nemmi tilet nih a thiangmi rili kam hna kha a den hna i, dinhnak le ruahnak cheuhnak a sawm hna. Rili thli lakah palm thingkung hna cu an i hninh, an muisam cu a senmi van he aa dang. Rili kam a kalmi hna nih ni an i hnim, thetse innpi an sak, cun rili cung nga pawl an khawmh hna, paradis a langhtermi nuamhnak sawhsawh ah an i tel. Ti tang ah, a nungmi lungpang hna cu rong aa dawhmi rili chung thilnung hna he an khat, ti thiang chungin hmuh khawh a si i khuaruahhar vawlei a thupmi a langhter. Zanlei a naih tikah, vancung cu a senmi le a senmi rong in a sen, hi dai tein a ummi rili kam ah ni dang a donghnak a langhter. Tikulh i a daihnak dawhnak nih nifatin nunnak aw-an in aa hlatnak hmun a pek.

Chanthar zung inn ah, riantuantu hna cu thlalang vampang a ngeimi tonnak khaan le riantuannak hmun a ongmi ah an i bawm. Computer aw le phone aw nih hnulei aw a chuahter peng, keyboard hmehnak le cauk pawl aa cawhmi nih a kham. Dinh caan nih dinh caan a kan pek, riantuan hawi hna nih coffee an din i bia an i ruah. Whiteboard le screen nih charts, project caan suaimi, le aa thleng lengmangmi ruahnak hna kha an langhter, an dihlak in tinhmi aa khatmi lei ah rian an ttuan. Rian a tam ko nain, chanthar thanchonak le hlawhtlinnak kawlnak a fiantertu tinhmi le thilthar sernak lungput a um.

A buai ngaimi tlanglawng dinhnak cu rel cawk lo tuanbia aa tonnak hmun ah cawlcanghnak pehtlaihnak ah a cang. Khualtlawngmi hna cu an tlanglawng tlaih awkah an i zuam, an kalnak ding hmun le an saduhthah cio he bawm le cakuat bawm hna kha an i tlaih. Zuartu hna nih aw le thawngthanhnak he a thangmi ticket zuarnak pawng ah rawl hme tete le thawngzamhca an zuar. Cuka hmun cu ruahchannak he a hninh i mawtaw mawngtu hna cu nunnak ah an au, chuahkehnak le phanhnak hmelchunhnak an tuah. Hi caan tawite chung hmun ah hin, pehtlaihnak le i ṭhennak caan hna cu an i cawh, a cawlcang bal lomi vawlei ah nifatin nunnak aw-an kha a hun langhter.

Ramlak chung thukpi ah, ni ceunak cu thinghnah hna lakah a luh i, a tanglei vawlei nemmi cungah a tlongmi hmanthlak a thlak. Thilnung phunkip cu an umnak hmun ah dai tein an i chawk, pakhat cio nih nunnak hri ah an rian an ttuan. Thli cu hling, thinghnah, le vawlei lum rim in a khat, hlanlio fekmi lungput a chuahter. Nemmi tiva pakhat nih thingkung hna lakah a kal, a aw-an cu dai tein a ummi ramlak ah a nuammi aw a si. Hi tawngh bal lomi hmunthiang cu sermi thil hna an tuar khawhnak le tongh bal lomi pawngkam dawhnak a hmunmi tehte a si peng.

Rawlchuan thiam hna nih rawl phunphun an timhtuah lio ah rian a tammi rawldawr cu cawlcanghnak in a khat. Skillets chungin a chuakmi aw cu thingthei, rimhmui, le changreu thar rim he aa cawh i, a nuammi pawngkam a ser. Thilri pawl cu an thleh, an cawh, le a dikthliar in an cawh, pakhat cio nih a thlum a almi hna i remhnak ah an bawmh. Riantuantu hna cu station karlak ah tluang tein an i chawk, plate pakhat cio nih tlamtling tein an phanh khawh nakhnga an i bawmh. Khual pawl nih an rawl an hngak, rawlchuannak sermi thilri pawl an i fonh tikah an i ruahchannak a karh — rawl pakhat cio cu lungthin lawmhter le thlarau lungtlinternak caah sermi zuksuai rian a si.

Zuksuai dawr ah, vampang pawl cu a phunphun in hmanthlak, milem suaimi le hmanthlak pawl in an i dawh. Khualtlawngmi hna cu pakhat hnu pakhat in zaangfah tein an i chawk, pakhat cio nih zukcawl thiam hna hmuhnak kha fianter le sunsak awkah an dir. Ceunak nih a sining le a hme tete kha a langhter, zuk suaimi hna kha nunnak a pek hna. Technique, lungthin le sullam kong dai tein biaruahnak nih hmuhtonnak ah thuknak a chap. Cu hmun cu sersiam khawhnak le ruahnak caah hmunthiang a si, cuka ahcun hmuh khawhmi langhternak thawnnak nih hmuhning thar a forh i khuaruah khawhnak a forh.

Tidil pawng i zingka tein, ti cung in khuadawm cu nem tein a hung chuak i, thlihran a ser. Vate pawl cu an hnulei ah tilet an chiah hna i an i hngilh, cu lio ah rulpi pawl cu thinghnah cung ah an zuang. Chunglei daihnak cu ni a donmi hla a sakmi va hna an aw nem lawng nih a hrawh. A pawngkam thingkung hna cu dai tein a ummi ti ah an lang, daihnak kha a let hnih in a karhter. Hi daihnak caan nih hin vawlei a thawh hlan ah dai tein a ummi sermi thil dawhnak kha a langhter, sermi thil sining ah a ummi daihnak a ummi aw-an kha a kan hngalhter ṭhan.

Puanzar a hung kai tikah theater meiinn cu a tlawm deuh, philh khawh lomi lemcangnak caah hmunhma a langhter. Lemcang pawl nih an rian ah an lut, duhnak le zumhnak he lemcang pawl kha an langhter hna, tuanbia kha nunnak ah an chuahpi. A zohtu hna cu an lung a thawh, hnihnak le kuttlaih nih a fahtermi caan le khuaruahhar thil sining hna kha a langhter. Hla le ceunak nih lungthin le boruak kha a ṭhanchoter, hmun kha khuaruah khawhnak le khuaruahharnak hmun ah a thlen. Puai a dih tikah, kuttlaih a hung chuak, mi vialte caah philh khawh lomi hmuhtonnak a sitertu thiamnak le zuamnak kha lawmhpi in.

Dai tein a ummi khua pawngkam ah, inn pawl cu tlar ttha tein an dir, pakhat cio nih pangpar le thingram in a khatmi dum an ngei. Lam hna cu theihhngalhmi hmai le hawikomhnak lungput he an i tthen, cu nih cun zatlang nun le daihnak a langhter. Ngakchia pawl cu innleng ah an i celh i upa pawl nih innchungkhar rian an ttuan asiloah innleng ah bia an i ruah. Nifatin nunnak i a nemmi aw-an nih hnemhnak a chuahter, inn le pehtlaihnak a biapitnak kha a langhter. Zanlei a hung phan tikah, innleng meiinn hna i a nemmi ceunak nih zan cu a don, khua pawngkam nunnak daihnak ah a um.

Tlang lam cu a tthawngmi hmun in a cunglei ah a tlik, a tliknak le lungpang a ummi tlanglawng in a kalmi hna kha a harter hna. Ke kar pakhat cio nih zuamnak le bia khiahnak a herh, tlangpar ah khuaruahhar in hmuhnak nih laksawng a pek. Tlang thli lum nih theihhngalhnak a thawnter, cu lio ah ramlak pangpar le a fekmi thingram hna cu lungpang hna ah an i hngat. A caancaan ah, lamhlatpi in mupi au thawng asiloah tlang cung meheh hmuhnak nih khualtlawngmi hna kha an pawngkam ramlak dawhnak kha a hngalhter ṭhan hna. A sangbik phanh cu teinak caan a si, inkhawhnak le sermi thil hna i khuaruahhar thilti khawhnak tehte a si.

Hlanlio khuapi chung i chawdawrnak hmun cu cawlcanghnak hmun a si, chawlettu hna nih an thilri an au i thil cawtu hna nih lungtho tein an zuar. Kut in sermi thilri, rimhmui le thilpuan hna in dawr pawl cu an khat, thilri pakhat cio nih khuapi nunphung rothil pakhat cio a aiawh. Ramdang rawl rim nih thli a khahter, lamkaltu hna kha a thlum thar ei awkah a lem hna. A pawng ummi hlasakthiam hna hlasaknak le laam thawng nih a nuammi boruak kha a karhter. Hi a buaibaimi hmunpi cu chawlehnak hmun lawng si loin a dang zong a si; tuanbia, nunphung le minung pehtlaihnak lam aa tonnak hmun a si.

Zan van tangah, meiphu a alhmi nih a bami khualtlawngmi hna hmai ah a laammi thlalang a thlak. Tuanbia i hrawm in hla sak in, hawikomhnak lawmhnak sawhsawh ah an i nuam. A alhmi mei nih a kikmi thli cungah lumnak a pek, cu lio ah a cunglei arfi hna nih cun a dong lomi khuaruahharnak vancung hmanthlak an pek. A hlatnak in a ummi uico au thawng le thinghnah hna nem tein an hninhnak nih a nuammi hnulei thil sining a ser. Hi caan ah hin, sermi thil le hawikom hna nih an kulh lio ah, caan cu a dir peng bantuk in a lang, lenglei khualtlawnnak hna i caan a liam bal lomi hlennak kha a langhter.

Fimcawnnak kong he pehtlai in tonnak nih vawleicung ramkip in mifim hna kha ruahnak cheuhnak le thilthar sernak kong ceihhmainak ah a pumh hna. Biachimtu hna nih thazaang petu cawnpiaknak an pek hna, biahalnak le riantuan ttinak lam thar an chuahter. Breakout sessions nih pehtlaihnak biaruahnak thazaang a pek, thil hngalh a duhmi lungthin a ngeimi bu a ṭhanter. Hngalhnak i hrawmnak cu pehtlaihnak puai le nunphung cawlcanghnak nih a bawmh, fimcawnnak leng hmuhtonnak kha a ṭhanchoter. Conference a dih tikah, aa telmi hna nih hmuhning thar le hawikomhnak a si khomi hna kha an chuahpi, cu nih cun anmah le an rian cio ah thanchonak a chuahter.

Khuapi cungah ruah nem tein a sur i, thlalang le inncung ah aw nem tein a hninh. Lamkaltu hna cu umbrella tangah an zam, an kedan cu a zam nain a zam lo, a lummi lamkam ah ceunak a ceu. Vawlei lum le ruah thar rim nih theihhngalhnak a thawhter, khuapi nunnak lakah tharchuahnak caan tawite a pek. Lam meiinn nih sui ceunak a chuahter, a lummi vanrang he aa dang, cu nih cun hmunhma ah a nuammi lumnak a pek. Lungdaihnak le daihnak nih a hlan i riantuannak kha a thlen, khuapi nih ruah nih a hnangamnak a cohlan tikah, mi vialte kha sermi thil nemte thawnnak kha a hngalhter hna.

Hlanlio biakinn cu minung thiamnak le thlarau lei tehte ah a dir, a lung vampang hna cu kum zabu tampi chung thli le nikhua nih a hrawh hna. A hmai ah a ttha ngaimi suaimi le milem hna nih an dawhter, biaknak le tuanbia kong an chim. Khualtlawngmi le khual pawl nih a daihnak hmun ah hnangamnak le thazaang an hmuh, cuka ahcun dai tein le upatnak nih thli a khahter. Biakinn a umnak nih hlanlio le tuchan kha a pehtlaih hna, nunphung rothil le sullam kawlnak a hmunmi hngalhternak ah a hman. Ni ceunak nih a tthennak le a tthencheunak hna kha a luhhnawh hna tikah, caan dongh lonak nih hmun cu a khuh.

A nungmi puai cu rong, aw le lungthawhnak in zoh dawh a si. Mawttaw cu aa mer i a zuang, lawmhnak au thawng in a khat, cu lio ah game dawr nih laksawng le hnihnak caantha an pek. Thilthuam aa hrukmi hlasakthiam hna nih mipi cu lentecelhnak, khuaruahhar thil tuahnak le hlasaknak in an nuamhter hna, kum upa vialte khuaruah khawhnak an lak. Cotton candy, popcorn le kio mi sausage rim nih aa pummi hna kha an i nuamhter hna. Zan a hung tlai tikah, a ceumi meiinn le hlasaknak nih lawmhnak, zatlang nun le nunnak nuamhnak sawhsawh hna a lawmhtermi thazaang a ngeimi boruak a ser.

Dai tein a ummi cauk chiahnak inn kam ah, cabuai pakhat cu meiinn nih a ceuter, reltu pakhat kha cauk chungah i hngilh dingin a sawm. Cahmai hna nih cun khualtlawnnak, hngalhnak le intuarnak vawlei hna kha an tlaih, pakhat cio cu hngalhthiamnak thar asiloah luatnak innka an si. A pawngkam daihnak nih lungthin peknak le ruahnak a chuahter, lenglei buainak in himnak hmun. A pawng ah, a konglam le catialtu ning in chiahmi thil chiahnak kuang hna nih minung ruahnak le sersiam khawhnak a ttha ngaimi a kan pek. Hi theih duhnak hmun nih hin relnak nih thazaang a pek, a cawnpiak i a thlen khawh ti kha a langhter.

Mitsur dum cu a tlongmi tlang hna cung ah a karh, a mitsur dum hna cu a hmin cangmi mitsur thei in a khat i rawl ṭuan awkah timhcia a si. Riantuantu hna cu tlar karlak ah ningcang tein an i chawk, an tan i an lak, pakhat cio nih ralring tein le thiamnak he vawlei kha an zohkhenh. Ni nih a hringmi ram cungah sui rong a thlak, a ceumi a hringmi le a senmi a thukmi kha a langhter. Thli cu thei le vawlei rimhmui in a khat, lo tuahnak nunnak a hrampi a langhter. Rawl ṭuan caan a naih deuhdeuh tikah, hi a sunglawi tukmi hna in ser rih lomi mitsur zu hna caah ruahchannak a karh.

Vur nih a khuhmi khua cu khuasik caan hmanthlak ah a tlingmi a si, inncung cu rang in an khuh i inncung ah tikhal aa thlai. Lam cu dai tein a um, vur a tlami nih a khuh, daihnak a chuahter. Ngakchia pawl nih snowman an ser i snowball an i phomh, an nih cu thli thiang chungin a thang. Inn hmete le dawr hna in a chuakmi meiinn lum hna cu a kikmi pawngkam he dawh tein an i dang, nuamhnak lunglawmhnak a chuahter. Ram vialte cu caan khuaruahharnak in a ceu bantuk a si, khuasik caan daihnak cohlan awkah mi vialte a sawm hna.

A buaibai ngaimi tilawng dinhnak khuapi ah, thilri phorhnak tilawng le nga tlaih tilawng hna cu tilawng dinhnak ah an i tlik, an tliknak tilawng cu van lei ah a phan. Tilawng dinhnak hmun riantuantu hna cu rang tukin an i thial, khuapi sipuazi a tthawntertu le vawleicung pumpi he aa pehtlaimi thilri pawl an phorh i an ṭhumh. Tilawng dinhnak pawng i chawdawr dawr hna nih khualtlawngmi le khuami hna caah nga thar, kut thiamnak le philhlonak thilri an pek hna. Ti thlum, rili sa, le diesel rim cu thli ah aa cawh i, rili nunnak nunnak a langhter. Lawng pawl an kal tikah asiloah an phanh tikah, khuapi cu cawlcanghnak, chawlehnak le rili nih a hnuh hna caah a ṭhangcho.

Changreu sernak thiamnak nih changreu sernak dawr cu a lummi, a sawmmi rim in a khahter i lamkaltu hna kha a chunglei ah a luhter hna. A thar in kio mi changreu le changreu pawl cu thil hmuhsaknak kuang chungah thiam ngaiin an chiah hna, an sui vun le a nemmi tthen nih lungthin a lem. Changreu sertu hna nih changvut an cawh i changreu an ser tikah an au, an thiamnak cu a hme tete ah a lang. Chawlettu hna nih a nuammi pawngkam kha an i nuamhpi, coffee asiloah ti he rawl an ei, rawl kio mi cung ah biaruahnak an i hrawm. Hi rawlchuan thiamnak nih hin mipi kha a cawm lawng si loin phunglam, sersiam khawhnak le rawl ttha lawmhnak sawhsawh hmangin a pehtlaih hna.

A buaibai ngaimi riantuannak hmun lakah, kut thiam hna nih an riantuannak ah fakpi in rian an ttuan, thil pakhat cio cu thiamnak le duhnak langhternak a si. Thilri hna cu thing le thir in puan le vawlei tiang an si, thiamsang hna nih a rawkmi thilri hna kha hman khawhmi zuksuai ah an thlen. Saw, hammer le loom hna aw cu sernak hla ah aa cawh. Khualtlawngmi hna nih kut thiamnak kha an uar tuk, anmah tein zuksuai riantuannak tuah awkah thazaang an pek tawn hna. Cawnnak cu minung fimthiamnak le kut in sermi, sullam a ngeimi thilri hna i a hmunmi hngalhnak tehte a si.

A tthawngmi puai chung ah, pangpar le meiinn in aa dawhtermi tilawng pawl cu lam ah an kal, nunphung rothil le zatlang nun lungput an lawmhpi hna. Thilthuam aa hrukmi hlasakthiam hna nih an laam i hla an tum, kum upa le ngakchia zohtu hna lungthin a lak hna. Rawl dawr hna nih phunglam ning tein rawl thawthaw an pek hna, a luan ciami chan hna i an thlum-alnak kha an i hrawm. Thli cu lungthawhnak, hnihnak le i telnak lunglawmhnak in a khat. Zan a hung tlai tikah, meithal puahnak nih van a ceuter, lawmhnak ah mipi a fonhtu a nuammi, philh khawh lomi puai a donghnak a langhter.

Dai tein a ummi khuate cu loram le ramlak hna he aa cawhmi a si, cuka ahcun caan cu a tlawm deuhmi a lo. Lo tuahtu hna nih thlaici le saram an zohkhenh hna, an tuah tawnmi cu kum zabu tampi chung phunglam ah hram aa bunh. Khuate hmete hna cu thingram hna lakah an i thup, inn hmete hna cu khuate dawhnak a chuahtertu an si. Thilnung aw nemte — vate hla, thinghnah hna lakah thli a hninh, lamhlatpi i a ummi caw aw — nih lungdaihnak aw a chuahter. Hi hmun dawh nih hin khuachung nunnak hnahnawhnak in luatnak a pek hna, khual pawl kha sermi thil nih a kuah hna tikah hmuhmi daihnak le fawinak kha a hngalhter hna.

Chanthar sizung ah, ngandamnak lei thiamsang hna nih mizaw zohkhenh awkah fakpi in rian an ttuan, an i pekchanhnak cu an tuahsernak kip ah a lang. A thiang lomi pawngkam cu cawlcanghnak hmunpi a si, nurse le sibawi te nih thlopnak an tawlrel i a biapimi hmelchunhnak pawl an zohkhenh. A sangmi thiamnak nih zawtnak thlopnak le damternak a bawmh, zawnruahnak le thilthar sernak i tonnak kha a langhter. Mizaw pawl nih riantuantu hna thiamnak le zaangfahnak ah hnangamnak an hmuh, ngandamnak le damnak hmuh ṭhan an i tinhmi kha an zumh. Hi hmun hi minung tuar khawhnak le damnak kawl pengnak tehte a si.

Ramcar cu a dong lomi in a kau, a linmi ni tangah thetse le lungpang a kau ngaimi a si. Cacti le a fekmi thingram hna cu hi pawngkam harsatnak ah nunnak ah an i tlaih peng, an tuar khawhnak nih khuaruahhar a chuahter. Khualtlawngmi hna nih ralrin tein hmunhma cu an kal, hi ramlak ah aa pehtlaimi ttihnung le dawhnak hna kha an hngalh. Khuaruahhar thil hna cu hlatpi ah an ceu, mit ah hlennak a tuahmi khuaruahhar thil hna nain vawlei sining a thli tein a langhter. Ni tlaknak nih ramcar cu mei bantuk a senmi le a senmi hmanthlak ah a thlen, sermi thil hna i an thawnnak le a liannganmi dawhnak a rauh hlan ah hmuh khawhmi a si.

Thingkung sang hna lakah a ummi inn nuam nih lenglei vawlei in himnak hmun a pek. Meiinn pawl cu an alh, a lummi ceunak an chuahter i khuate thilthuam he aa tlak. Khual pawl cu cauk he an i din asiloah tuanbia an i hrawm, an i dinhnak daihnak kha an i nuamhpi. Lenglei ah, vur cu nem tein a tla, vawlei cu a rang in a khuh, cu lio ah chunglei ahcun, lumnak le hnangamnak nih a uk. Hi naihniam tein umtuning nih hin a sawhsawh tein kirnak le sermi thil nih a kuahmi hnangamnak kha a langhter, dinhnak le tharchuahnak caah luatnak tling a si.

Khuapi chung i a nuammi zukcawl zohnak hmun ah, lemcang pawl cu hnulei ah an i timhtuah, an thinphannak le an lungthawhnak cu a lang. Orchestra nih an thilri pawl kha an remh hna i kuttlaih le bia alnak nih auditorium kha a khahter. Puanzar a hung kai tikah, puai cu drama, hnihchuak, asiloah ngaihchiatnak vawlei ah aa thleng, zohtu hna lungthin a lak hna i lungthin lei lehrulhnak a chuahter. Lemcawnnak lungrualnak — lemcang, hlasakthiam, stage riantuantu — nih cu caan te lawng ah a ummi caan tawite chung thil lianngan pakhat a ser. A donghnak hmanthlak a dih i kuttlaih a hung thang tikah, lemcang thiamnak nih mi vialte kha tuanbia chimnak le minung langhternak thawnnak kha a hngalhter hna.

Daihnak a ummi siangbawi inn tual cu ruahnak cheuhnak le daihnak hmun a si. Siangbawi pawl cu biakinn chung ah dai tein an i chawk, dum an zohkhenh i nifatin thlacamnak caah timhtuahnak an ngei. Rimhmui le a parmi pangpar rim nih thlarau lei umtuning a chap, lungthin thiang le daihnak a chuahter. Khualtlawngmi asiloah khuasa mi hna nih siangbawi nunnak a sawhsawh le phunglam ah hnangamnak an hmuh, cuka ahcun ruahnak le zatlang nun aa pehtlai. Kum zabu tampi a liam cangmi phunglam ah hram bunhmi, hi hmun thianghlim nih hin lenglei vawlei buainak lakah thlarau caah hmunthiang a pek.

A rian a tammi saknak hmun ah, riantuantu hna nih inn thar saknak ding caah an i zuam, pakhat cio nih an thiamnak an pek. Thir thawng le seh thawng nih tthanchonak a langhter, himnak phunglam nih mi vialte a himter hna. Thilri pawl cu a tlarimi lam in an phan — concrete, thir hri, lungvar — project tthatnak caah a herhmi tthen pakhat cio. Inn suaisam thiam le engineer pawl nih rian cu an zohkhenh, suaisamnak cu zumhawktlak tein tuah khawh a si ti kha an hngalhter. Cu hmun cu minung saduhthahnak le timhtuahnak hna kha a tak ah canter awkah a herhmi riantuan ttinak tehte a si.

A nungmi coral reef cu rili ti thiang tang ah nunnak in a khat. Nga rong phunphun cu coral thinghnah hna lakah an zuang, cu lio ah aa dawh ngaimi rili rul pawl cu an zuang. Rili kam i a harmi thilnung hna nih saram phun tampi a bawmh hna, pakhat cio nih tlukruannak ngeih pengnak ah a biapi tukmi rian an ttuan. Snorkelers le divers pawl nih hi tichung paradis hi an zoh, a dawhnak le a phunphun in an khuaruah a har. Hi a derthawmmi umnak hmun pawl kilven cu a ra laimi chan hna caah rili chung thilnung rumnak kilvennak caah a biapi tukmi a si.

Dai tein a ummi Buddhist biakinn ah, siangbawi pawl nih phunglam le thlacamnak an tuah, daihnak le thlarau lei lungthin peknak boruak an ser. Zihmui rim cu van ah a hung thang i hlasaknak hna cu nem tein a thang i, a tuahtu hna kha chunglei ah a hruai hna. Milem le pathian hmanthlak hna nih thlacamnak le ruahnak caah hmunhma an pek hna, pehtlaihnak le upatnak lungput an chuahter. Daihnak le hngalhthiamnak a kawlmi khual pawl nih biakinn i a hmunmi daihnak ah hnangamnak an hmuh. Cu bantuk hmun thianghlim hna cu chunglei hlathlainak le zawnruahnak cinnak caah himnak hmun ah an cang.

Ski tuahtu le snowboard tuahtu hna nih vur a tamnak tlang le tlang lam an kal lio ah a nuammi ski tuahnak hmun cu cawlcanghnak in a khat. Lift thutdan nih khual pawl kha tlangpar tiang a kalpi hna i, vur nih a khuhmi vawlei kha a kau ngaimi hmuhnak a pek hna. Nikhat chung khualtlawnnak an tuah hnu ah, khual pawl cu inn nuam ah an i pum, tuanbia an i hrawm i mei alh in an i lum. Chocolate lum le rawl thaw taktakmi rim nih thli a khahter, lungthawhnak a hnu bik a chuahter. Hi khuasik lentecelhnak hmun cu lungthawhnak, sermi thil le hawikomhnak lawmhnak a si, vur a alh hnu zongah caan saupi a hmunmi philh khawh lomi thil a ser.

A thiammi laboratory chung ah, scientist pawl nih ttha tein hneksaknak an tuah, a dikthliar le thiamnak cungah i hngatchan in. Thilri pawl cu ceunak tangah an ceu i annih nih sample pawl an hlathlai i data an khumh, vawlei cung thilnung asiloah thiamnak lei thanchonak kong theihhngalhnak an kawl. Riantuan ttinak le theih duhnak nih an riantuannak kha a hruai hna, a caan ah zatlang nun ah a thami thlennak a chuahter khomi hlawhtlinnak a chuahter. Pawngkam cu ukmi ningcang le rikhiah um lomi kawlnak cawhmi a si, hmuhchuah le thilthar sernak minung thlarau a langhter. A phichuak paohpaoh nih theihthiamnak le thanchonak kawlnak ngan deuh ah a bawmh.

Main Street i a nuammi cauk dawr nih cauk a dawmi hna kha a hmai dawh le cauk tampi in a khatmi thil chiahnak kuang hna he a lem hna. Ca reltu hna nih ralring tein thimmi cauk pawl kha an zoh, caṭialtu thar le caan a liam bal lomi cauk hlun hna kha an hmuh hna. Cauk hlun rim nih khual pawl kha a khuh hna, tuanbia le hngalhnak hmuhchuahnak i tawngh khawhmi nuamhnak kha a ṭhanchoter. Hawikomhnak a ngeimi riantuantu hna nih ruahnak cheuhnak an pek, hmuhtonnak ah pumpak pehtlaihnak an chap. Caholh caah hi hmun nih hin zatlang nun, khuaruah khawhnak le cawnnak a thanchoter, biafang le a sunsakmi hna karlak pehtlaihnak a cawmken.

A kau ngaimi thingram dum ah, vawleicung hmunkip in a tthangmi thingram hna cu ttha tein chiahmi tthen ah an langhter hna. Lam hna cu a tthawngmi pangpar cinnak hmun, dai tein a ummi tidil hna le a thli tein a ummi thingram hna chungin an i mer i, hlathlainak le daihnak a sawm hna. Dum ngeitu hna nih thingram pakhat cio kha dawtnak he an zohkhenh hna, a tlawmmi phun pawl kilvennak le vawlei dawhnak kha an hngalhter hna. Khualtlawngmi hna nih thingram phunphun an hmuh tikah an khuaruah a har, pawngkam pehtlaihnak le dum tuahnak thiamnak kong an cawn. Dum cu a thiammi le a thar in a rami hna caah hmunthiang a si, sermi thil khuaruahhar le minung fimthiamnak a nungmi thilthuam a si.

A nuammi nuamhsaihnak hmun nih a roller coaster, Ferris kedan le lentecelhnak hna he lungthawhnak le lumnak a pek. A ceumi meiinn le a nuammi hlasaknak nih a naihnak le a hlatnak in mibu a hnuhmi thazaang a chuahtertu boruak a ser. Ngakchia le upa hna nih lawmhnak le nuamhnak caan an tong, nuamhnak le santlaihlonak lakah philh khawh lomi thil an tlaih. Concession dawr nih cotton candy in a thawmi rawl tiang an pek hna, cu nih cun pehzulh tein khualtlawnnak a chuahter. Hi nuamhsaihnak le hnihnak nih lungrethei lo tein nuamhsaihnak a fawinak le nuamhnak kha a lawmhpi, mi vialte kha hmuhtonnak i hrawmmi ah hmuhmi lawmhnak kha a hngalhter hna.

Dai tein a ummi khuate inn ah, khual pawl nih nifatin nunnak buainak in dai tein dinh caan an hmang. Khuate thilri le ceunak lum nih nuamhnak a ser, cun rawl thawthaw nih hnangamnak le nunnak a pek. A pawngkam vawlei nih a tlikmi lo le dai tein a ummi thingram hna a langhter, lamkalnak le ruahnak cheuhnak caah a ttha tuk. Khualtlawnnak inn ngeitu nih khual dawtnak a ngeihnak nih anmah he aa pehtlaimi sinak le nuamhnak a chuahter i khual pawl kha inn ah a ummi bantuk in a umter hna. Hi a fawinak le a sining nih a tharchuahmi dinhnak a pek hna, khualtlawngmi hna kha khuate nunnak i a rang deuhmi, timhcia deuhmi kalning he a pehtlaihter ṭhan hna.

A ttha ngaimi, chanthar museum nih zukcawl, tuanbia le science thilri phunphun a langhter. Khualtlawngmi hna cu ralring tein thimmi thilri hna chungin an kal, pehtlaihnak thilri le theihternak panel hna he an i pehtlaih. Inn sakning hrimhrim cu zuksuai riantuannak a si, a chung i langhtermi thilri pawl he aa tlakmi thilthar suaisamnak aa tel. Fimcawnnak program le special puai hna nih theih duhnak le cawnnak a chuahter. Museum cu a luan ciami, a tu le hmailei aa pehtlaimi tlanglawng lam a si, khual pawl kha fimthiamnak phunphun ah minung sersiam khawhnak le fimthiamnak kha sunsak awkah a forh hna.

Dai tein a ummi tlangpar ah, biakinn hmete nih a pawngkam vawlei kha a zoh, a inncung cu van lei a phan. Khualtlawngmi le khual pawl cu hnangamnak hmuh awk, thlacam awk, asiloah khuaruahhar thil hmuhnak nuamhnak caah an ra. Lung vampang le a sawhsawh mi chunglei nih toidornak le upatnak a langhter, thlacamnak le pehtlaihnak caan a chuahter. Cu hmun cu minung nih thlarau lei ṭhanchonak le hngalhthiamnak an i zuamnak kha a kan theihter ṭhan. Ni tlak tikah, biakinn cu sermi thil kauhnak lakah ruahchannak le daihnak meiinn bantukin a lang.
